messages:
Nina K: quick sync  need to resolve GA gating for the enterprise-compliance workstream. main pillars: audit evidence exports, tenant key integration, and retention policy enforcement. what are the non-negotiables?
Devon R: sales feedback: customers want a verifiable chain-of-custody for exports (who requested, which key, hash of bundle). simpler ask than full escrow for most.
Omar T: eng constraints: two risky areas  (a) per-tenant TTLs hitting our distributed cache, (b) exporting encrypted blobs with signer metadata. both feasible but need explicit e2e tests.
Priya S: propose acceptance criteria for GA candidate: 1) export manifest schema defined + sample, 2) manifest includes key_fingerprint + requestor_id + timestamp, 3) retention override (legal-hold) visible in manifest & console, 4) export path supports streaming for <100GB/day + queued bulk for larger.
Nina K: agree. priority question: BYOK support at GA? phased OK?
Devon R: customers split: SMBs OK with service-managed keys, banks want BYOK+escrow. recommend BYOK off-by-default for GA but provide handshake API in v1 for tenants to register a CMK (no escrow). label customers needing escrow as pilot.
LegalBot: legal check: any export bundle must include jurisdiction tag and residency assertion if data is copied across regions. also need retention policy record for audit (who changed TTL, when).
Omar T: technical note: we'll add X-Tenant-Residency header and X-Tenant-Retention-Source to audit events. need to update prefix cache TTL propagation so cached tokens respect updated retention.
QA-bot: test cases to add: (A) export-manifest validation, (B) legal-hold override flows, (C) cross-region export where residency=false should fail w/ 403, (D) key rotation during in-progress export should not invalidate active download.
Priya S: we should define Minimal Evidence Package (MEP) for SOC2: audit.log (line-delimited JSON), manifest.json, key_metadata.json (fingerprints + provenance), and a signed checksum file. auditors want deterministic packaging.
Devon R: pricing question: exports cost model? ops wants per-GB + egress estimate and a retention storage surcharge for customer-borne cold-archive.
Nina K: roadmap split suggestion: sprint 1 = manifest + streaming exports + retention API + registry for tenant keys (register-only), sprint 2 = queued bulk exporter + console controls + GA readiness docs, sprint 3 = optional indexing + BYOK escrow + long-term archive.
Omar T: estimate: sprint1 = 2 engineers x 3 sprints (ingest changes + streaming exporter + key registry API + tests), sprint2 = 2 eng x 2 sprints, sprint3 = 3 eng x 3 sprints (indexing + escrow + archive plumbing). rough numbers.
Priya S: acceptance checklist for GA: - MEP sample generated for at least 3 tenants (incl. EU) - residency assertions validated - retention override audit visible - BYOK register API present - docs & runbook published - export SLA published for streaming path
Devon R: client ask: can export include signed statement from our platform including key id + fingerprint? yes please, helps auditors.
LegalBot: also add export revocation playbook: how to handle a discovered violation after an export was generated. need retention of the revocation decision in the audit trail.
Nina K: decision question: GA after sprint2 (with BYOK register only) or wait for sprint3? leaning GA after sprint2 with guardrails (index opt-in, escrow pilot). votes?
Priya S: vote GA after sprint2 if Legal signs off on residency gating. otherwise pilot.
Devon R: vote GA after sprint2. ops ready for staged rollout.
Omar T: vote GA after sprint2 but require feature flag gating & throttles.
QA-bot: testing condition: if GA, enable canary for 10 tenants first, then widen.
Nina K: agreed. action items: - Omar: tech spec + cache-retention patch PR by Thu EOD, - Priya: MEP manifest schema + sample bundle by Fri, - Devon: export cost model + sales-facing FAQ by next Wed, - LegalBot: residency checklist & revocation playbook by Mon. i'll consolidate for planning doc.
Devon R: small sample export manifest to include in docs:
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1.0",
  "tenant_id": "t-987",
  "exported_at": "2025-02-10T15:03:00Z",
  "requestor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "bundle_checksum": "sha256:3b7f...",
  "key_fingerprint": "SHA256:AbCdEfGh...",
  "residency": "eu",
  "retention_source": "legal_hold",
  "files": ["audit.log", "events.jsonl", "signed-checksums.txt"]
}
```
Priya S: CLI example for customers:
```
redwood-cli evidence export --tenant t-987 --since 2024-01-01 --format tar.gz --manifest --stream
```
Omar T: note: implement server-side manifest signing with a platform key, store signature in bundle as manifest.sig.
LegalBot: final legal note: keep export audit chain for 10 years for high-risk financial customers; mark as configuration in console.
Nina K: closing: thanks all. i'll post consolidated spec + pilot gating table tomorrow morning. if anyone objects to GA after sprint2, flag in thread within 24h. :white_check_mark:
